evidence.quote: the fallout from the crisis has nonetheless been very severe, as reflected in the depth of the global recession and the deep declines in employment both here and abroad.
With the financial turmoil abating, now is the time for policymakers to take action to reduce the probability and severity of any future crises.
Regulators and supervisors can do a great deal, but comprehensive financial reform requires action by the Congress.
